heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee generally agrees that any AI policy must be adaptive and regularly updated in response to evolving technology, emerging risks, and observed outcomes in practice. There is broad alignment that static policy will quickly become outdated.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee also recognizes that AI capabilities are evolving rapidly and that students are already interacting with these tools outside of school. As a result, policy reassessment should not only respond to risks, but also ensure that FCCPS continues to prepare students to engage with AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: There are important tradeoffs regarding how reassessment should occur. These include balancing the need for timely updates with the risk of constant change creating confusion, determining the appropriate level of formal review versus administrative adjustment, and ensuring that updates are informed by real-world data rather than reactive responses.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recommends a structured but flexible approach to policy reassessment that supports continuous learning while maintaining stability and clarity.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recommends that new or higher-risk uses of AI begin as bounded pilots rather than immediate system-wide implementation.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Pilots should:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: have clearly defined goals and intended outcomes

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: include guardrails appropriate to the level of risk

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: be limited in scope and duration

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Piloting should also be used as an opportunity to better understand how AI can support learning, not only to identify risks.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recommends that FCCPS define clear criteria for evaluating the impact of AI use.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: This may include:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: identifying anticipated benefits (e.g., instructional support, efficiency, access)

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: establishing baseline conditions prior to implementation

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: measuring outcomes over time

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Evaluation should consider both benefits and unintended effects, including impacts on student learning, equity, and teacher workload.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee agrees that FCCPS should have a clear process for responding to incidents involving AI tools.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Examples of incidents may include:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: false accusations related to academic integrity

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: privacy or data exposure concerns

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: harmful or inappropriate outputs affecting students

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Response processes should include:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: clear escalation pathways

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: defined responsibility for review and action

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: timely communication where appropriate

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Incident response should prioritize student well-being, fairness, and transparency.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recommends that implementation occur in phases, recognizing that some elements can be implemented immediately while others require additional infrastructure, training, or evaluation.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: This may include:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: identifying which practices can begin immediately

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: determining which require pilot programs

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: sequencing more complex implementations over time

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: A phased approach supports thoughtful adoption and reduces disruption.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recommends establishing a regular review cycle for AI policy and related guidance.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: This may include:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: annual administrative review

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: periodic School Board review

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: accelerated review when triggered by significant incidents, technological change, or new evidence

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Review processes should be predictable, but also responsive when needed.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee emphasizes that reassessment should be informed by ongoing input from students, families, and staff.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Feedback mechanisms described in WS-POL-H should be integrated into the reassessment process, ensuring that lived experience informs policy updates.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Policy should evolve based on:

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: observed outcomes in classrooms

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: implementation challenges

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: emerging risks and opportunities

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: The committee recognizes that continuous reassessment must be balanced with the need for stability and clarity.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Frequent or poorly communicated changes may create confusion for educators and families, while delayed updates may limit the ability to respond to new risks or opportunities.

heading_path: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
sections.text: Policy should therefore define a clear framework for reassessment while allowing flexibility for timely and practical updates.

title: WS-POL-K — Reassessment and Updating of Policy
